messages:
sam: Thanks all — quick follow-up from today’s all-hands. I posted the updated org realignment slide and headcount glidepath. Drop questions here and we’ll answer live.
elaine: TL;DR: we’re reallocating ~12 roles from infra to product platform over FY28 to support Dedicated & Private demand. No net layoffs. :wave:
matt: Can you share which teams specifically get the increased IC capacity?
sam: Product Platform, Serving Runtime, and Observability teams get the bulk. Small pulls into Sales Eng and Solutions for customer integration L6+ roles.
ryan: timeline question — when do hires ramp vs internal moves?
elaine: Hiring cadence: Q2 we do internal moves and backfills, Q3 external hiring ramps. Target: 8 internal moves by end of Q2, 12 external offers issued in Q3.
anya: Are there role level changes for people who move teams? Salary/title preserved?
elaine: Yes — we’re honoring level and comp bands for internal transfers. If leveling changes, we’ll do 1:1 discussions before any change.
chris: For teams losing headcount (infra), is there a plan to reduce scope or reprioritize work?
sam: Good callout. We have a 90-day scope review for impacted squads to triage projects; PMs and Eng Leads will publish a reprioritized roadmap by next Wednesday.
matt: Could we get the headcount numbers in a tiny table here for clarity?
elaine: Sure — pasted minimal breakdown below:
```
team, delta_roles
Product Platform, +7
Serving Runtime, +5
Observability, +3
Infra Core, -9
Customer Success, +2
Sales Eng, +1
```
ryan: For people interested in internal moves, what's the process?
elaine: Submit an internal mobility form (link posted in #people-ops) and talk to your manager. We’ll host office hours Fri 10–11am for Q&A.
anya: Will there be role-specific hiring freezes anywhere?
elaine: No outright freezes. We’re pausing new external hiring in Infra Core for Q2 while we assess scope; critical exceptions can be approved by execs.
chris: Any change to ramp targets for Dedicated availability SLAs because of this shuffle?
sam: No SLA target changes — we’re shifting engineers to hit our Dedicated commitments sooner. Ops will publish updated milestone dates in the roadmap doc.
clarity-bot: Note: roadmap doc v2 uploaded by sam at https://redwood.internal/handbook/org/realignment-v2
matt: Appreciate the clarity. Quick ask — can leads get a CSV export of the glide path? Makes local planning easier.
elaine: Will share CSV tomorrow and set up a 30-min sync with Eng Leads.
sam: Thanks everyone. If anything else pops up, DM me or post here. We’ll keep the thread open through EOD. :thumbsup:
